message: Wrap the control in FormField from @groam/ui/components/form-field instead of pairing a Label with it. FormField wires the label id, required/optional marks, helper text, counter, and error the same way everywhere.

examples.source:
import { Label } from '@groam/ui/components/label';
export const view = <Label htmlFor="name">Name</Label>;

import { FormField } from '@groam/ui/components/form-field';
export const view = <FormField label="Name"><span /></FormField>;
